text: Delivered in merge 0b3ccf7 (commits 856b704, cdf2ab9). plan/Preflight.scala: typed StudyFinding/RecordingFinding/TemporalFinding enums naming trial keys, definition ids, artifact refs, clocks, frames, windows and areas, each with severity, category and remedy; StudyReport/RecordingReport/TemporalReport bound to the full plan description and input digest, refusing ChangedPlan (with PlanChange diff), ChangedInput and NotReady; blockers derived from the plans' own prerequisites so the two cannot drift; pair schedules paged under the supplied budget; no estimation, comparison, warping or detection performed (sentinel-counted). PlanChange.between factors the description diff for all three plan families. docs/PREFLIGHT.md. PreflightSuite: 12 tests per platform covering the ticket's tables, constructor/run cross-checks, sentinels, stale readiness and deterministic ordering. Fresh-context review: merge after fixes, all applied. planJVM/JS 25/25, codec 24/24, boundaries clean on main.
